verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, so operating it with natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of offering. The llms.txt file only describes the firm for AI readers and is not a command interface. The Clerky formation platform is a third-party partner's workflow tool with no documented natural-language control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
